canon_hooks.native_excerpt: "You amuse me, mortal. Very well. Be on your way. If you happen to see Shamira, tell her I say hello... unless you've already encountered her, of course. I'm sure you can see yourself out — you did find a way in, after all."

canon_hooks.native_excerpt: "And you decided to report back to me after you finished the job? How kind. But do you know what? I won't hold it against you. Shamira was starting to forget her place. She was no longer content to rule Alushinyrra on my behalf... She coveted my throne. You've saved me the trouble of having to deal with her."
